Commercial property for sale in Surrey: industrial buildings and strata units, offices, retail space, commercial land and businesses listed on the MLS®. This search shows properties for sale only; spaces for lease are not included. Call or text Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361 for a property that is not listed, or to value one you own.
Commercial and industrial areas in Surrey

items.t: Surrey has 2,713 hectares of industrial land in the regional inventory (July 1, 2025), the most of any city. Its largest areas are Campbell Heights (770 ha), Newton (449 ha), Bridgeview (343 ha) and South Westminster (341 ha). ([Metro Vancouver 2025 Industrial Lands Inventory](https://metrovancouver.org/services/regional-planning/Documents/mv-industrial-lands-inventory-summary-report-appendices-2025.pdf), read November 20, 2026)

Buying a Surrey business: the City licence does not simply carry over. A change of owner costs $25 and needs a copy of the purchase and sale agreement, and the City may ask for more, such as health permits. ([City of Surrey, updating your business licence](https://www.surrey.ca/business-economy/business-licensing/updating-your-business-licence), read November 20, 2026)

blocks.text: In the second quarter of 2026, 53 commercial properties sold in Surrey (against 44 a year earlier), worth $249.9M in all: 19 industrial, 15 land, 7 office, 12 retail and other, and 0 multi-family.
Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS® Commercial Edge, Q2 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).

Industrial space in the Surrey submarket (45.1M sq ft) was 4.2% vacant in the third quarter of 2026, asking $19.66 per sq ft net plus $6.95 in additional rent, with 1,628,917 sq ft under construction. Across Metro Vancouver vacancy was 4.0%.
Source: Avison Young, Metro Vancouver industrial market report, Q3 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).
City of Surrey commercial and industrial zones

Zoning decides what a commercial property can be used for. These are the City of Surrey zones on the zoning guide; each links to its permitted uses, smallest new lot and height limits. Check the zone of a specific address before you buy.
